scope: 64 distinct published Markdown pages, each retaining its latest actual inspected revision. Five new or affected pages were checked at b60418f; other pages retain their earlier recorded checks. browser: Installed Microsoft Edge, headless Chromium via bundled Playwright; live public GitHub pages with JavaScript and MathJax enabled.

limits: This is a rendering and link audit, not a mathematical proof or a scientific peer review.
